loreEntries.title: The Age of Rime and Ruin
loreEntries.text: Four centuries past, the ancient High Kingdom shattered when the Great Frost Wyrm Vyr descended from the volcanic peaks. The kingdoms fractured into fortified holds, and the secret art of runecraft was nearly lost to the encroaching ice.

loreEntries.title: The Slumber of Vyr
loreEntries.text: Legends etched into the barrow slates recount that Vyr was not slain, but bound beneath the obsidian crater of Mount Wyrmfang by three runic star-keys forged from star-iron.

loreEntries.title: Sky-Iron and Rune-Forging
loreEntries.text: Sky-iron fell from blazing stars upon the glacial peaks. When quenched in glacier water and carved with Torvald's runes, it yields armaments that never dull and bite through dragon scales.

loreEntries.title: The Draugr of the Old Reaches
loreEntries.text: Those warriors who swore blasphemous blood-oaths to the Wyrm were entombed alive within stone barrows. Their corpses remain vigilant, clad in blackened iron, striking down any who disturb their funeral urns.

loreEntries.title: The Law of Hearth and Salt
loreEntries.text: In the Northern Realms, no host may harm a guest who has tasted bread, salt, and spiced juniper mead beneath their timber roof. Breaking hearth-peace marks a warrior as an outcast across all holds.
